text: Comcast announced a tax-free spinoff of NBCUniversal and Sky into a separate publicly traded company. Comcast shareholders will hold shares in both companies. Leadership assignments for each entity were identified. The transaction remains subject to board and regulatory approval and is expected to complete in about one year.

meta.note: Continuity and fragmentation coexist because shareholder ownership spans both resulting entities.

text: The Supreme Court declined to hear Donald Trump's appeal of the federal jury verdict awarding E. Jean Carroll $5 million. The lower court judgment remained in effect. No written dissent accompanied the order. A separate appeal concerning an $83.3 million defamation judgment remains pending in a lower federal appeals court.

meta.note: A separate civil case remains active but is outside the scope of this atomic event.

text: The Supreme Court held that federal election-day statutes do not preempt Mississippi's law allowing absentee ballots postmarked by Election Day and received within five days to be counted. The ruling reversed a prior appellate decision. A 5-4 majority issued the opinion with a written dissent.

meta.note: Subsequent political statements and legislative advocacy are separate events outside this ruling.
